notes: v2.9.21: darkens the chart canvas to medium gray to reduce contrast with the black main UI; Ichimoku cloud fill is now opaque and concrete zones use stronger translucent fill. Bowl-3 is no longer assigned from a score-only 224 breakout: it requires EMA224 breakout followed by a real pullback that holds EMA224 or at minimum EMA112, with that support still alive and no excessive distance above EMA224. Pre-confirmation stages are not labeled Bowl-3. The 7 day-search initial union now uses complete paged general queries first, then realtime registration with pacing/retry; status separately shows initial-union and realtime registration counts so candidates such as stocks beyond the first result page are not silently missed.
